comingLast.roast: 6 holes for a jailbreak - 2 points cuts the wire
sitting 1 above Todd and driving very, very carefully
5 points of breathing room at 1.3 a hole - shallow breaths
5 clear - describing it as comfortable would be generous
6 points is all that separates him from a very blue evening
the buffer reads 6 - his group reads it aloud each tee
a 7-point moat between him and Todd's crown - shallow moat
his 8-point buffer is doing a lot of heavy lifting
